trust_decision.summary: Strings from the OpenAPI document (schema defaults, property names, paths, server URLs/variable defaults) are treated as data and must be escaped for the literal they get embedded in (template literal, single- or double-quoted string, object key) in generated TS modules; decided per emit site in the code generators.

landing_point.why: The summary names 'array-items default -> zod module-level template literal'; this is where stringify() output of schema.default has its single quotes swapped for backticks and is emitted as `export const xDefault = ...`.
